CHRISTNER'S PRIME STEAK & LOBSTER

Is CHRISTNER'S PRIME STEAK & LOBSTER clean? Not quite — only a C, 73/100, the last time the state checked (April 7, 2026). That visit logged 2 high-priority, 2 intermediate, and 5 basic violations.

Its most recent inspection on April 7, 2026 cited 2 high-priority, 2 intermediate, and 5 basic violations. It currently ranks safer than 10% of Orange County restaurants we grade. Diner rating: 4.6 from 1,830 reviews.

    I love going to this place a few times a year or more. They usually have good steaks. However on this particular occasion the steak wasn't cooked correctly. She didn't want me to say anything at the restaurant but, this was a bad experience and at a normally great place. And worst of all the only reason she lets me go to this restaurant is the carrot cake and they were out. Unfortunate series of events. 3 stars because its normally good. But if it was my only time there I would give 1.

  • ★★★☆☆ June 22, 2026

    I was able to make a same-day reservation for our 29th wedding anniversary. My husband and I thought about three other steakhouse options, but at the last minute decided to dine at Christner's since we hadn't visited in a few years. Well, I was pretty disappointed. The service and our waiter were very accommodating and friendly. The food, on the other hand, was definitely below my expectations. I ordered the Dry-Aged Bone-In Ribeye. At over $100, I thought my steak would taste exceptional, but sadly it didn't. Honestly, the steak tasted like it was prepared/cooked at an Outback/Longhorn restaurant. I also ordered a Caesar salad. At $16, it was very lacking in quantity, freshness, and dressing. My husband ordered the regular Bone-In Ribeye. He ordered his steak medium, but when it arrived, it seemed burnt on the outside. We shared the lobster mac and cheese. The taste was okay, but it seemed to be missing the lobster. Well...we did see some little pieces of lobster, but I was expecting at the very least one or two larger chunks. The one thing that was perfect during our dinner was the bread and butter. I mentioned to my husband that I would not return to dine at Christner's. Now I wish we would have chosen another steakhouse to celebrate our wedding anniversary.
